description.value:
Performance comes naturally to you. Choose one musical instrument. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with the chosen instrument, or expertise if already proficient. While playing it for an audience, and for up to 1 minute afterward, you have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to read the emotions of those who were listening.

This feat can be taken multiple times, choosing a different instrument each time.
